name: Stagalbog
summary: Along the southern mountains, Stagalbog remains an untamed stretch of marsh, south of the Pool of Tears.

sections.title: The Southern Mire
sections.body: Below the southern crags, stagnant water gathers among drooping reeds and tangled growth. The tainted Pool of Tears borders Stagalbog to the north, with the sunken ruins of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar just beyond. Rough wildlife roams the mire, where civilization has made no foothold.

sections.title: Shadow of the Temple
sections.body: Beside the Pool of Tears, Stagalbog lies under the shadows and corruption seeping from the Sunken Temple.

faq.answer: Stagalbog lies in the southern Swamp of Sorrows, directly south of the Pool of Tears along the base of the southern mountain range.

faq.q: What threats can be found wandering the bog?
faq.answer: Native marsh beasts and predatory creatures roam the bog.

angles.text: Damp, shaded roots in Stagalbog provide prime growing conditions for swamp flora that thrive away from trodden paths.
Between the marsh water and mountain cliffs, Stagalbog's quiet stretches give native swamp beasts room to roam.
